The team note's positional zip approach would return an empty result for the required example, since no values match at the same index. That fails `assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))) == set((4, 5))`, so I kept the set-intersection version, which passes the assertion.

```python
def similar_elements(test_tup1, test_tup2):
    return tuple(set(test_tup1) & set(test_tup2))


assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))) == set((4, 5))
```

CONFIDENCE: 95
